THINGS_CHROMATIC_FISSION_POWER.smartDesc: When killed, splits into [blue]{Amount}[/blue] smaller [gold]{Amount:plural:Chromatic Slime|Chromatic Slimes}[/gold] based on the killing blow: Attack overkill of [blue]5[/blue] or more spawns [gold]Crimson[/gold] (offense), less than [blue]5[/blue] spawns [gold]Amber[/gold] ([gold]Block[/gold]), and non-Attack kills spawn [gold]Azure[/gold] ([gold]Slimed[/gold] and [gold]Weak[/gold]).
THINGS_ABYSSAL_COVER_POWER.title: Tentacle Cover
THINGS_ABYSSAL_COVER_POWER.description: Takes [blue]25%[/blue] less Attack damage for each living major tentacle. Severing a major tentacle deals [blue]20[/blue] recoil damage, applies [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], and immediately washes all [gold]Ink Blackout[/gold] cards clean.
THINGS_ABYSSAL_COVER_POWER.smartDescript: [gold]{OwnerName}[/gold] takes [blue]{Amount}%[/blue] less Attack damage while protected by living major tentacles. Severing any major tentacle deals [blue]20[/blue] recoil damage to [gold]{OwnerName}[/gold], applies [blue]2[/blue] [gold]Vulnerable[/gold], and immediately washes the entire deck clean and restores randomized costs.
THINGS_INK_BLACKOUT_POWER.title: Ink Blackout
THINGS_INK_BLACKOUT_POWER.description: Next turn, ALL cards in your deck (even after reshuffling from Discard) are drenched in abyssal ink under a unified custom border, hiding all identifiable details and hover tips while randomizing Energy costs between [blue]0[/blue] and [blue]3[/blue]. Cleared at turn end or immediately when a major tentacle is severed.
THINGS_INK_BLACKOUT_POWER.smartDescripti: For the next [blue]{Amount}[/blue] {Amount:plural:turn|turns}, ALL cards in your deck (including reshuffles and generated cards) are drenched in abyssal ink under a unified border with all card info & hover tips hidden and Energy costs randomized ([blue]0[/blue]–[blue]3[/blue]). Cleared at turn end or immediately when a major tentacle is severed.
THINGS_ABYSSAL_SURGE_POWER.title: Abyssal Surge
THINGS_ABYSSAL_SURGE_POWER.description: Empowered in the abyss: attacks hit harder and summoned tentacles smash directly through the stone bridge.
THINGS_ABYSSAL_SURGE_POWER.smartDescript: [gold]{OwnerName}[/gold] has entered its enraged abyssal phase: attacks hit harder and summoned tentacles smash directly through the stone bridge.
THINGS_ABYSSAL_TEMP_STRENGTH_POWER.title: Ink Surge Channel
THINGS_ABYSSAL_TEMP_STRENGTH_POWER.descr: Temporarily gains extra [gold]Strength[/gold], which is lost at the end of its next turn.
THINGS_ABYSSAL_TEMP_STRENGTH_POWER.smart: [gold]{OwnerName}[/gold] loses [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] at the end of its spray turn.
THINGS_ABYSSAL_TEMP_THORNS_POWER.title: Barbed Infusion
THINGS_ABYSSAL_TEMP_THORNS_POWER.descrip: Temporarily gains extra [gold]Thorns[/gold] until the end of the player's turn.
THINGS_ABYSSAL_TEMP_THORNS_POWER.smartDe: [gold]{OwnerName}[/gold] loses [blue]{Amount}[/blue] [gold]Thorns[/gold] at the end of your turn.
THINGS_ABYSSAL_TEMP_WARD_POWER.title: Carapace Ward
THINGS_ABYSSAL_TEMP_WARD_POWER.descripti: Temporarily reduces incoming Attack damage until the end of the player's turn.
THINGS_ABYSSAL_TEMP_WARD_POWER.smartDesc: [gold]{OwnerName}[/gold] takes [blue]{Amount}%[/blue] less Attack damage during your turn. Removed at the end of your turn.
